question: 4ddc9df3369e: when a trouble clears and its file leaves CairnCommons/troubles/, where does it go — (a) ~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/artifact_archive/trouble_tickets/ sweepable after 30 days as the ticket's how says, or (b) a git-kept quiet store in the commons such as CairnCommons/troubles/cleared/ per your 2026-09-15 retention ladder, or (c) somewhere else?
why_it_blocks: The ticket's owner line reserves this to Akien ('Akien owns the design choice of whether cleared troubles go to the 30-day artifact archive or a longer-lived quiet store'); its how (2026-08-29) says ~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/artifact_archive/trouble_tickets/ aging out at 30 days, but the 2026-09-15 retention ladder says what a developer needs at 45 days lives in CairnCommons, and a cleared trouble is the record of what broke and what fixed it. Measured 2026-09-17: 233 files in CairnCommons/troubles/, 222 CLEARED and 11 OPEN, so the first clear under location-as-liveness moves 222 records out of git. The trouble charter also says 'The records are git-JSON in CairnCommons/troubles/ — losing it loses knowledge'.
